owner: DM 1794921306.773839 (codex archer: gap between bow and body filled dark instead of see-through; asks whether all others get the same inner-space treatment)
method: Each frame's alpha mask was registered (scale 0.85-1.12, offset search, IoU) to the matching figure of its generation sheet: proof/<set>_dirs/regen|regen2/<dir>_<act>.png (fullsets-refinish and from-mini), teppo regen/full+aimset, bow_attack frames bow-art-1117/v7/gen/<general>-<dir>.png; units/*.png were rebuilt with the imjin pipeline geometry (units-atlas / enemies-clean-atlas cell + specs/unit-layout.json, alpha identical to the shipped file). Source coverage was area-reduced to sprite pixels. A pixel became transparent when it is opaque, filled with the dark outline colour (rgb sum < 200) or a light background colour (white/beige), lies in the source background (coverage <= 0.2) and in the interior of that background region (4-neighbour erosion, robust to 1 px registration error), is not next to the exterior, and is not 4-adjacent to any non-dark body pixel (so a 1 px outline stays around every hole); components < 2 px were dropped; light fills are only cleared when the light region is ringed >= 70% by dark outline (keeps muzzle flashes). Frames registering below IoU 0.78 were not changed and are listed for review. bph-* soldier variants take their base frame's pixels (identical alpha); webp sheets take the pixels of the exact matching frame (flip-aware).
